scope: Pinned Python bindings for existing-document forms and annotations

qualification.runtime: Optional pinned wheel; disposable nonroot Linux worker with hard 2 GiB address-space/120 second ceilings and native network/process confinement
qualification.input: Source bytes retained; input at most 50 MiB; whole-document form/edit workflows limited to 100 pages
qualification.output: 1000 fields, 2000 annotations, 2 MiB report/export, 16 MiB aggregate output; no truncated success
qualification.configuration: 32 KiB strict JSON; 100 edits; no arbitrary method dispatch or user output paths
qualification.coordinates: Native PDF user-space coordinates; one-based source pages, zero-based annotation indices. Explicit highlight correction preserves CropBox/Rotate handling and accepts only 0/90/180/270 rotation, UserUnit 1 and rectangles wholly inside MediaBox intersection CropBox; no inferred layout or coordinate normalization.
qualification.independent_validation: PyMuPDF structural reopen and existing field-value checks; saved flattening additionally uses bounded pikepdf page/annotation graph comparisons. Explicit highlight correction uses pinned pikepdf 10.17.0, records its backend and retains the defective native comparison. These checks do not establish general visible appearance accuracy.
qualification.graph_limits: Annotation/resource graphs at most 100000 nodes/depth 64; cumulative decoded page-content plus resource streams at most 16 MiB per snapshot; absolute native numeric metadata tolerance 0.001. Textual numeric values and decoded stream hashes are exact. Budget or verification failure publishes no candidate.

capabilities.details: Exact field report and per-page widget annotations; get_form_field_value also validates pending filled values.
verification: exact numeric strings and leading zeros

capabilities.details: Properties retained in JSON; native bounds are not relabeled as normalized screen coordinates.

Text/null, standard /Yes boolean checkboxes, single choices and multi-select arrays. Saved requested and untouched values must match exactly. Native choice validity independently checked. Readonly/signature/unknown/push-button/radio fields, duplicate names and non-/Yes checkbox states fail closed. Encrypted rewrites fail because encryption cannot be preserved by this route.
verification: independent native and PyMuPDF saved numeric/multiline strings
limitations: Visible field appearance and Unicode glyph coverage require visual review
Radio string setter serializes PDF strings rather than name states; no supported radio repair is claimed

capabilities.details: XFA presence reported; XFA form mutations/export/flatten fail closed. No XFA extraction, rendering, filling or XML import method exists in the pinned Python binding.

App-owned generated output filename only. Exact JSON report accompanies native FDF. Only ASCII names/values and representable button export names accepted; Unicode fails closed because pinned writer uses raw UTF-8 literal PDF strings. Export operates on a freshly opened source, never unsaved editor changes.

Scalar Unicode XML export with parsed-value check against exact source fields. Reject DTD/entities, XML-invalid/control-normalized names/values, arrays and empty strings. Pinned upstream comma-joins arrays and omits empty-string value elements.
No FDF/XFDF import method is exported in Python 0.3.78. A bounded JSON fill workflow is implemented and is not presented as native FDF/XFDF import.

Explicit allow_flatten; selected widgets or entire AcroForm flattened in a derivative. Every native flatten_warnings entry is treated as a possible content-loss signal and rejects the output with bounded diagnostic text. Saved selected widgets must be absent; selected page geometry and non-widget annotation graphs must remain intact. Unselected page geometry, decoded content, inherited Resources, page Group and annotation graphs must match independently through pikepdf. XFA is unsupported. Interactivity changes; passing these checks is not appearance qualification.
verification: actual selected-page widget removal with other-page widgets and non-widget notes preserved
actual all-page AcroForm removal and retained source text
native blank-signature appearance warning reproduced and rejected without PDF
limitations: Native missing-appearance behavior remains defective; no appearance reconstruction is performed by flattening
No general field appearance, Unicode glyph or source/output pixel equivalence claim

capabilities.details: Read metadata available from get_annotations including literal contents/URI, field data, author, subject, dates, opacity and rectangles. Page.annotations delegates to get_annotations in the binding; the app calls get_annotations directly.

PdfPage.annotations and PdfAnnotation.subtype are called for removal validation. Native rect/contents/color getters are not called directly; equivalent persistent metadata is exported via get_annotations. Transient is_modified/is_new editor flags are not exposed by the app. FormField/PdfAnnotation have no public native constructor; values are returned by native document APIs. No claim that all wrapper getters are separately implemented.

Strict action allowlist. Links limited to HTTP(S)/mailto without credentials; no link is fetched. Native saved counts, metadata, rectangles, contents and retained page text checked; existing annotations kept. Output is structurally reopened independently.
verification: unknown keys, paths and script/file URI rejection

capabilities.details: Native geometry/color metadata and successful serialization do not establish a visible highlight. Native output has malformed bow-tie QuadPoints in MuPDF and no PDFium appearance. The default path rejects highlight actions before spawn. An explicit allow_highlight_repair option invokes the separately documented pikepdf correction and retains native-unverified.pdf; it does not fix or qualify the native method.
verification: explicit correction has separately named candidate, diagnostic and backend provenance
capabilities.recovery_evidence: External evidence/forms-highlight-appearance-probe-2/test_added_highlight_has_visib0 preserves source, wrong output, report and PDFium render; the final review pack includes the negative case.

capabilities.backend: pikepdf==10.17.0 after pdf-oxide==0.3.78 creates the new annotation
capabilities.details: Only new annotations exactly matching the known native lower-left/lower-right/upper-right/upper-left QuadPoints and missing AP are corrected. The requested rectangle must be at least 0.5 PDF points per dimension and fully inside the effective visible crop; supported rotations are 0/90/180/270 and UserUnit must be 1. Unknown geometry, appearance or identity is rejected. No layout inference or generic failure bypass occurs. Correction sets upper-left/upper-right/lower-left/lower-right QuadPoints and an explicit rectangular Multiply appearance stream.
capabilities.preservation: Before and after correction, compare page geometry, decoded content, inherited Resources, page Group and original annotation graphs. Existing form-field values and metadata must remain unchanged. Absolute native numeric metadata tolerance is 0.001; textual numeric values and decoded stream hashes are exact. Native and corrected files share the existing atomic aggregate output budget.
outputs: forms-annotations.json: explicit backend/version/opt-in, source/native/candidate hashes, requested/native/corrected geometry, appearance hash and preservation checks
verification: real PDFium and MuPDF comparisons for all supported rotations and offset crop
numeric text and black text pixels preserved
untouched page pixels identical in tested cases
existing annotation graphs and form values retained with mixed additions
unknown native shape, unsupported geometry, resource changes and output-budget overflow rejected
limitations: Native add_highlight remains defective and the default path remains blocked
Successful reconstruction of an explicit rectangle is not general annotation/layout/source-fidelity qualification
Parent Ada acceptance and merge hold remain in force

capabilities.details: Method returns True and save succeeds but the reopened PDF retains removed original annotations in a real synthetic test. Runtime saved-metadata check rejects the output. Widget removal is refused; no alternate parser silently substitutes for PDF Oxide.
capabilities.recovery_evidence: External evidence/forms-test-run-1/test_annotation_add_remove_reo0 contains the original and erroneous pre-guard native output/report; preserved for review.

capabilities.details: Explicit allow_flatten; existing widgets require separate form flattening. After serialization, native and independent pikepdf readers must find no remaining selected annotations. Independently compare all unselected page geometry, decoded content, inherited Resources, page Group and annotation graphs; selected geometry must remain intact. Actual link-only and no-appearance-highlight cases persist natively and are rejected without output. Native flatten marks or successful serialization are not correctness proof.
verification: selected page annotation removal in supported cases
actual link-only annotation persistence rejected for selected and whole-document modes
limitations: Removal of interactivity is not proof of retained visible appearance

capabilities.details: The app selects final flatten pages before editing, so no pending marks are exposed across requests. This state-mutator has no independent durable artifact; selected-page exclusion provides the user-visible result. No arbitrary persistent editor session is created.
New-document field creation and builder verification are delegated to oxide_creation; this inventory makes no completion claim for those methods.
New-document annotation builders are owned by oxide_creation. Existing-document Python annotation additions expose only note/highlight/link.

No private keys, certificates, signing or form JavaScript is loaded/executed. Signature inspection/security belongs to oxide_security. Existing signature fields are not filled by this module; rewriting signed documents records invalidation.
